sensor: Thermal: uncooled VOx, 384x288, 17 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD <= 35 mK (25 C, F1.0); optical: 1/2.8in CMOS, 4 MP
features: thermal + optical bi-spectrum network mini positioning system (thermographic)
optical channel: 4 MP (2688x1520), 1/2.8in CMOS, 32x optical zoom (4.8-153 mm)
IR illuminator up to 30 m on the optical channel
temperature measurement -20 to 550 C, accuracy Max (+/-2 C, +/-2%)
behavior analysis (line crossing, intrusion, region entrance/exit) via built-in GPU / deep learning
fire detection and temperature exception alarm
release_notes: The HikMicro HM-TD5537T-15/W is a compact thermal/optical bi-spectrum mini positioning system with a 384x288 thermal module (15 mm lens) and a 4 MP 32x optical channel, providing behavior analysis, fire detection and thermography up to 550 C.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Thermal and optical exposed as separate channels (optical Channel 1, thermal Channel 2).
